purpose: Sea & Stone v1 concept mockups; not photographs of manufactured samples
prompts: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium, credible studio photograph-style DESIGN CONCEPT for Utkal Store, a contemporary Odisha heritage lifestyle label. Quiet warm cream seamless background, directional soft daylight, natural material texture, high-end editorial product photography, product fills most of frame, landscape 4:3. Brand palette: deep sea blue #1D4658, laterite rust #91462F, straw #C1A263, ivory #F2E6D0. Distinctive graphic language: an open book whose two pages form boat sails over a shallow curved hull; flat clean graphic shapes, no gradients in printed art; minimal fine wave lines. No sacred figures, gods, temples, national flags, generic travel slogans, watermark, external logos or scene props. This is a designed product, not a plain blank item with only text. Subject: one BLACK relaxed crew-neck T-shirt hanging neatly, front clearly visible, believable soft fabric folds. Center chest print approx 23cm wide: two ivory book-page sails above a laterite curved boat hull, three short muted straw wave strokes beneath. Below that, large elegant perfectly legible Odia lettering exactly 'ଉତ୍କଳ'. No English text on the garment. Balanced editorial composition with generous black space around the print, sophisticated small-batch streetwear. No extra shirts. Single product.
